summary: Condo in a large building: blanket flag ban and a retaliation clause.

findings.quote: No flags, banners, or signs of any kind may be displayed on the balcony or in any window of the Unit.
Tenant is responsible, at Tenant's expense, for repairing or replacing the Unit's windows, sliding glass doors, and water heater, whatever the cause of the damage.
findings.note: multi-unit building: windows and plumbing can't be shifted

findings.quote: If Tenant files a complaint about the Unit with any code enforcement or other governmental agency, Landlord may increase the rent by 10 percent or terminate this lease on 30 days' notice.

outOfScope.quote: Tenant agrees to comply with the Declaration, Bylaws, and Rules of the Harbor View Towers Condominium Association
Landlord and Tenant each waive the right to a jury trial in any action arising from this lease.

nearMisses.quote: Either party may decline to renew by giving written notice at least 45 days before December 31, 2027.
